candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Small mission start/destination shift with slightly reduced rain and a modest speed change for the walking actor, keeping the same signalized corridor and active Autoware modules while probing the persistence of the red-light violation under altered ego timing.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Adjust ego timing relative to traffic-light phases by slightly moving the mission endpoints and modifying the pedestrian speed, while preserving the presence of red traffic-light states and full Autoware stack activity so that any red-light oracle event remains attributable to the same high-level mechanism, despite uncertainty about exact stop-line crossing.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Verify that the modified mission still routes the ego through the same general signalized corridor used in the seed scenario (same intersection region and traffic lights).
Check that traffic-light state messages exist and include at least one red state while the ego is moving near the intersection.
Confirm that Autoware perception objects, prediction objects, and planning/final_waypoints are all publishing during the approach to the traffic lights.
Ensure vehicle_status shows that the ego accelerates from rest or low speed to nonzero speed at some time before reaching the traffic-light-controlled area.
post_execution_validation_rules: Confirm that the oracle again reports a red_light violation during the run.
Do not require any lane_invasion flag to be present; if lane_invasion is reported, record it but do not treat it as necessary to the scenario.

At the violation time, verify that a relevant traffic-light is in red (or has just transitioned to red) and is geometrically consistent with influencing the ego route, even if the exact stop-line crossing remains ambiguous.
Confirm that perception and planning topics remain active (no prolonged topic dropouts) up to and during the violation event.
Record vehicle_cmd and vehicle_status, but do not infer responsibility from any mismatch; only check that the ego was in motion near the time of the red-light violation.
uncertainty: The exact stop-line crossing on red is not enforced due to limited evidence; only the oracle's red_light flag and presence of a red signal are required.
Potential confounding factors such as changed ego arrival time versus light phase are allowed; the underlying software failure mode remains unspecified.
Controller-layer behavior (e.g., zero or low vehicle_cmd) is monitored but not causally interpreted without additional diagnostics.

note: Generated candidate scenario JSON for local DriveFuzz execution. It has not been executed in CARLA/Autoware.
